Life expectancy in the United States rose to 77.5 years in 2022 [1]. The rise was driven mainly by fewer COVID-19 deaths and better cancer screening [1]. Heart disease and cancer remained the two leading causes of death in 2022 [1]. The Mediterranean diet was first proposed in 1975 by Ancel Keys [2].

Sources:
[1] https://www.cdc.gov/nchs/data/databriefs/db492.pdf
[2] https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mediterranean_diet
